name: black-friday (MacPlus-Software)
accepts: A vendor's own sale page (30% off its Mac apps, 1 to 30 Nov 2026) with a 'Friends' table of 'Mac apps from makers we like'. Mac only.
how_to_submit: No contributing rules anywhere in the repository. One outside pull request adding a Friends row was merged on 15 Nov 2026.
entry_format: Friends columns: App, What it does, Deal (bold discount, code in bold, struck-through old price, bold new price, end date). Not alphabetical.
rules: The README asks for a star 'to find it again next year'. That is a request, not a condition.
status_note: Created 12 Nov 2026, 0 stars. 12 merged pull requests, 11 of them the vendor's own branches; 1 outside deal merged (15 Nov 2026). No stated route, so a row is a guess at what the owner takes.
